## Collaboration

I welcome discussions on potential collaborative research projects, including academic partnerships and research collaborations with public institutions or industry. For an overview of my current research interests and agenda, please see the [Research](research.html) page.

## Students and Early-Career Researchers

I am happy to hear from motivated students and postdoctoral researchers whose interests align with the areas above.
When reaching out, please include:

- A CV (PDF)
- A brief statement (1–2 paragraphs) outlining your interests and research goals
- (Optional) a writing sample or code repository

## Possible Ways to Join

- MSc thesis supervision (LUMC) and internship (RIVM) 
- PhD positions (subject to availability and funding) 
- Visiting research stays  
- Fellowship-based positions (see below)

## Fellowship Opportunities

Prospective applicants are encouraged to consider external funding schemes. Examples include:

- [Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA PF)](https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/postdoctoral-fellowships)  
  For postdoctoral researchers applying to work in Europe. This may be relevant for applicants considering LUMC or RIVM as a host environment.

- [EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships](https://www.embo.org/funding/fellowships-grants-and-career-support/postdoctoral-fellowships/)  
  For internationally mobile postdoctoral researchers in Europe and around the world. This may be relevant for applicants whose proposed project fits within the life sciences.

- [HFSP Postdoctoral Fellowships](https://www.hfsp.org/funding/hfsp-funding/postdoctoral-fellowships)  
  For internationally mobile postdoctoral researchers proposing frontier, interdisciplinary life-science projects. This may be especially relevant for applicants moving between quantitative, computational, or engineering backgrounds and infectious disease research.
  
- [JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship (学振PD)](https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-pd/)  
  For postdoctoral researchers applying to work in Japan. This may be relevant for applicants considering a stay at Nagasaki University. Remote working may be negotiable, with Nagasaki University as the host institution.

- [JSPS Overseas Research Fellowship (海外特別研究員)](https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-ab/)  
  For Japan-based early-career researchers seeking overseas research experience. This may be relevant for applicants considering a stay at LUMC or RIVM.

If you are considering applying for a fellowship with me as host or collaborator, please contact me well in advance of the deadline.
